Gamma_comp_note: Gamma_comp repeats Gamma_comp_lower.  It is the LOWER side of the bracket -- the value of a design that was actually achieved -- so 1/Gamma_comp is the LARGER end of the benchmark interval, not a point prediction.
note: the oracle arm is a diagnostic that reads the true world
model_class: centered per arm, box |mu_e| <= BOX_B, carried as solver constraints
lipschitz_note: 2B / min_e var_e, computed from the observation model rather than fixed at 2B

elimination_horizon.note: the allowance 2 L r_t depends on the radius and the Lipschitz modulus, not on alpha, so no confidence level reaches this horizon before stopping; the selection rule is tested directly instead of through the runs
